subject: 12 12 12 (Apple TV series)
title: What does 12 12 12 mean? The Apple TV heist series title, explained
answer: The title of Apple TV's heist thriller 12 12 12 refers to the three timelines in each episode: 12 months to plan the robbery, 12 hours to pull it off and 12 days to escape. The eight-episode series, starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, premieres Friday, Nov. 13, 2026.
body:
Mackie plays a disgraced FBI agent and Dornan an American career criminal in what Apple describes as a cat-and-mouse game across Europe. The centerpiece is a raid on a bank vault deep beneath the streets of Zurich, and each episode jumps among the planning, the heist and the aftermath. Jack Kesy, Agathe Rousselle, Sallie Harmsen, José Garcia and Kali Reis also star.

The first two episodes arrive on Nov. 13, followed by one new episode every Friday until the finale on Dec. 25, 2026. Despite the name, the show does not premiere on Dec. 12. Apple has promoted 12 12 12 as a scripted thriller, and its announcements do not describe it as based on a real robbery.
in_the_news: Apple TV premieres 12 12 12, a heist series starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, on Nov. 13, 2026.
